sources.title: Hal Jordan Inspired Ring - Free 3D Print Model - MakerWorld
sources.snippet: Bring a piece of the Green Lantern universe to your collection with this Hal Jordan-inspired ring! Modelled in Shapr3D using screenshots, posters and official stills as references, this fan-made design captures the ring's appearance rather than reproducing it at a verified, screen-accurate scale.
